import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

n = n.copy()
n["week"] = n["date"].dt.to_period("W-SUN").dt.start_time
weekly = n.pivot_table(index="week", columns="shop_id", values="neg", aggfunc="mean").sort_index()
monthly = n.assign(month=n["date"].dt.month).pivot_table(index="shop_id", columns="month", values="neg", aggfunc="mean")
focus_shop = (monthly[10] - monthly[9]).idxmax()
jump_week = weekly[focus_shop].diff().idxmax()
sept_max = round(float(weekly.loc[weekly.index < jump_week, focus_shop].max()), 3)
counts = n.groupby(["shop_id", "week"]).size().loc[focus_shop]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
ax.bar(weekly.index.to_pydatetime(), weekly[focus_shop].to_numpy(), width=4)
ax.set(xlabel="Понедельник недели", ylabel="Доля сигналов", title=str(focus_shop), ylim=(0, 1))
ax.set_xticks(weekly.index.to_pydatetime())
ax.set_xticklabels([d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in weekly.index], rotation=45, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print("focus_shop:", focus_shop, "jump_week:", jump_week, "sept_max:", sept_max)
print(pd.DataFrame({"доля сигналов": weekly[focus_shop], "число отзывов": counts}).to_string())
